title: Suicide stand-down in the drone program
summary: Dylan Borland tells of Suicide stand-down in the drone program, about 2013 at US Air Force drone locations, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: They were calling me up and they're like, "Yo, we had a suicide standown."

plain: A man named Dylan Borland says that in 2013 people working in the US Air Force drone program called him with troubling news. According to Borland, they told him they had just had a "suicide stand-down," meaning work was paused so everyone could deal with suicides among the crews. He tells it to show how heavy the strain inside that program was.
